newsitem.title: USA: Shaw Group names Edward Pagano new CFO.
newsitem.headline: Shaw Group names Edward Pagano new CFO.

text.p: The Shaw Group Inc said Wednesday that it named Edward Pagano chief financial officer. Pagano replaces Bret Talbot, who the company said resigned to pursue other interests.

Shaw said Pagano spent the past eight years with Kvaerner John Brown, where he was senior vice president and chief financial officer for the company's U.S. operations. Kvaerner John Brown is a division of Kvaerner A/S of Norway.

Shaw also said it is implementing a new business structure to more efficiently addresses the needs and opportunities within its growing enterprise and the industries it serves, by organizing the company into three units.

The three groups are Shaw Power Services Inc, which specializes in engineering, design and fabrication of piping systems and the design and manufacture of pipe hangers and supports for the electric power industry; Shaw Process and Industrial Group Inc, which specializes in pipe fabrication, as well as project construction and maintenance for the chemical and refining industries; and Shaw Products and Services Inc, which specializes in the manufacture and distribution of specialty pipe components.
